_comment: Authoritative gate-layer sources used by scripts/fetch-gate-seeds.js to build gates-seed.json. Each entry is a publicly queryable (anonymous) ArcGIS REST layer published by the airport operator or a government GIS. geometry: 'point' reads geometry.x/y, 'polygon-centroid' queries with returnCentroid=true. strip_prefix is removed from the start of gate codes (case-insensitive). researched_not_found records airports checked for a public layer with no usable result, so the gate-seed-scout routine doesn't re-research them more than ~6 months.

sources.publisher: Chicago Department of Aviation (Chicago_Ohare_Gates feature service)
sources.note: Shipped with the original seed; no refetch — the source service was an Esri aviation-community mirror and the baked data is verified good.

sources.publisher: HNTB Corp AGO org (CLT program management; backs CLT's public gate-closure dashboard)
sources.note: Gates duplicated across construction phases; fetcher medians duplicates per gate code. View-hash URL may churn.
